name: Money laundering through deposits + payment rails
description: Bad actors place illicit funds, layer through internal transfers and payment rails, then integrate via legitimate purchases or transfers. Detected only post-event without behavioural rules.

name: Sanctions breach via outbound payment
description: Outbound SEPA/SWIFT to a sanctioned beneficiary or sanctioned correspondent. Regulatory breach and potential criminal liability.

name: Authorised push payment (APP) fraud loss
description: Customer is socially engineered into authorising a payment to a fraudster. Bank may be liable under reimbursement rules (e.g. UK PSR).

name: Card / e-commerce fraud
description: Lost / stolen / cloned card or compromised credentials used for fraudulent purchases. Chargeback and reimbursement liability.

name: Money-mule account onboarding
description: Criminals (or coerced individuals) open accounts to receive and forward stolen / illicit funds. Detected only when fraud victim reports loss.

name: Market abuse on trading desk
description: Insider dealing, front-running, layering or spoofing by trading desk staff. MAR breach + regulatory action.

name: AML failure via correspondent / nested relationship
description: Correspondent bank fails to screen its underlying customers; illicit flows route through your nostro account.
